content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "That's great, Hayes Valley confirmed for the 14th.

Next I'd lock a headcount, even a rough one, since that drives everything else, the room setup, food order, and invites.

Then get the invite out this week. Three weeks out is a good window, but replies slow down fast once you're inside two weeks.

Food and drink next, find out what the venue allows (do they host, can you bring outside catering) so you know who you're actually coordinating with.

Once those three are set, a seating or run of show is the last piece, and that one you can leave until closer to the date."

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
